correctness.rationale: The regular-design Gram identity, Sherman--Morrison update and row-sum duality prove the exact finite outlier norm. Projection diagonals give a uniform bounded norm for every ordinary row. Shifted bounded-variation quadrature for both the absolute kernel and its radius derivative gives uniform error bounds; the leading scale profile has a unique nondegenerate maximum. Every optimizer avoids upward derivative cusps and solves a stationary equation yielding the stated \(\pi/4\) radius shift and \(1/2\) norm intercept. A standalone independently inverted finite checker passed 21642 assertions; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Compared relevant published mathematical statements by claims, aliases, equivalences and implications, then inspected the nearest full primary sources and mathematical results. A three-character cyclic projector gives only the unperturbed ordinary-grid kernel; a simplex projector is continuous-volume and has no variable-leverage atom; the general least-squares and regression-influence sources do not imply the radius optimizer or its uniform second term. This is a best-knowledge originality PASS, not a proof of no earlier equivalent.
